methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (mobile) in Brazil at 76.59% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 19.63%, followed by Samsung Internet at 2.63%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in Brazil?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 76.59% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/brazil.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in Brazil?
faqs.answer: Chrome (76.59%), Safari (19.63%), Samsung Internet (2.63%) in October 2026.
